\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{পদক} (pôdôk)}{পদক (pôdôk)}]{\bn{পদক} (pôdôk) — a medal}

\label{lesson:BN-C520-podok}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a referee, then the Bengali for to be beaten.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{পদক}}
\textbf{\bn{পদক}} — \emph{pôdôk} — \textquotedblleft{}a medal\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{সাঁতারে} \bn{মেয়েটা} \bn{একটা} \bn{পদক} \bn{জিতল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Sā̃tāre meyeṭā ekṭā pôdôk jitlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The girl won a medal in swimming.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{পদক}} (\emph{pôdôk}) is a Sanskrit word built on \emph{pada}; Monier-Williams gives \emph{padaka} as a kind of ornament, and the sense \textquotedblleft{}a medal\textquotedblright{} is the modern language's own.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pôdôk}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pôdôk}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Sā̃tāre meyeṭā ekṭā pôdôk jitlô.} — The girl won a medal in swimming.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a referee, then the Bengali for to be beaten, then say \emph{pôdôk} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{পদক} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A medal\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{ট্রফি} (ṭrôphi)}{ট্রফি (ṭrôphi)}]{\bn{ট্রফি} (ṭrôphi) — a trophy}

\label{lesson:BN-C520-trophi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for to be beaten, then the Bengali for a medal.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{ট্রফি}}
\textbf{\bn{ট্রফি}} — \emph{ṭrôphi} — \textquotedblleft{}a trophy\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমাদের} \bn{স্কুল} \bn{ক্রিকেটের} \bn{ট্রফি} \bn{জিতল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Āmāder skul krikeṭer ṭrôphi jitlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Our school won the cricket trophy.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{ট্রফি}} (\emph{ṭrôphi}) is borrowed from English \emph{trophy}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{ṭrôphi}, once more

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for to be beaten, then the Bengali for a medal, then say \emph{ṭrôphi} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{রেকর্ড} (rekôrḍ)}{রেকর্ড (rekôrḍ)}]{\bn{রেকর্ড} (rekôrḍ) — a sporting record; a best result}

\label{lesson:BN-C520-rekord}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a medal, then the Bengali for a trophy.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{রেকর্ড}}
\textbf{\bn{রেকর্ড}} — \emph{rekôrḍ} — \textquotedblleft{}a sporting record; a best result\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{সাঁতারে} \bn{ছেলেটা} \bn{একটা} \bn{নতুন} \bn{রেকর্ড} \bn{গড়ল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Sā̃tāre chheleṭā ekṭā nôtun rekôrḍ gôṛlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The boy set a new swimming record.
\end{quote}

With \bn{গড়া}: \bn{রেকর্ড} \bn{গড়া}, to set a record.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{রেকর্ড}} (\emph{rekôrḍ}) is borrowed from English \emph{record}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{rekôrḍ}, once more

  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a medal, then the Bengali for a trophy, then say \emph{rekôrḍ} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]

\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{প্রতিযোগী} (prôtijogī)}{প্রতিযোগী (prôtijogī)}]{\bn{প্রতিযোগী} (prôtijogī) — a contestant; a competitor}

\label{lesson:BN-C520-protijogi}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a trophy, then the Bengali for a sporting record.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{প্রতিযোগী}}
\textbf{\bn{প্রতিযোগী}} — \emph{prôtijogī} — \textquotedblleft{}a contestant; a competitor\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{প্রতিযোগিতায়} \bn{দশজন} \bn{প্রতিযোগী} \bn{ছিল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Prôtijogitāy dôshjôn prôtijogī chhilô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
There were ten contestants in the competition.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{প্রতিযোগী}} (\emph{prôtijogī}) is Sanskrit \emph{pratiyogin}, \textquotedblleft{}one who is set against another\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams); \bn{প্রতিযোগিতা}, a competition, is built on it.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prôtijogī}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prôtijogī}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Prôtijogitāy dôshjôn prôtijogī chhilô.} — There were ten contestants in the competition.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a trophy, then the Bengali for a sporting record, then say \emph{prôtijogī} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{প্রতিযোগী} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A contestant; a competitor\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{জেতানো} (jetāno)}{জেতানো (jetāno)}]{\bn{জেতানো} (jetāno) — to lead to victory; to make win}

\label{lesson:BN-C520-jetano}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a sporting record, then the Bengali for a contestant.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{জেতানো}}
\textbf{\bn{জেতানো}} — \emph{jetāno} — \textquotedblleft{}to lead to victory; to make win\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{অধিনায়ক} \bn{একা} \bn{দলকে} \bn{জেতাল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{Ôdhināyôk ekā dôlke jetālô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The captain won the match for the team on her own.
\end{quote}

Past (he/she …): \bn{তিনি} \bn{দলকে} \bn{জেতালেন}, \emph{tini dôlke jetālen}.

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{জেতানো}} (\emph{jetāno}) is built on \bn{জেতা}, \textquotedblleft{}to win\textquotedblright{}, as its causative partner: to make someone win.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jetāno}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jetāno}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{Ôdhināyôk ekā dôlke jetālô.} — The captain won the match for the team on her own.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a sporting record, then the Bengali for a contestant, then say \emph{jetāno} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{জেতানো} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}To lead to victory; to make win\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
